page.notes: Greek entries at the top left (πατρᾳλέχη, πατρᾳλέχος) and the Greek word in the right column (περιουσίᾳ) are my best reading of the letters and are marked [?]. The Greek printer's mark at the lower right of the page is not transcribed. Small dot at lower left is ink, not text. Some lines are cut short at the column edges and may hide letters, but none are visibly lost. Long s is plain s throughout; the printed f-like forms in "fui", "fuccessores" and similar words are read as printed.
